blocks.orig: Ole Serai Luxury Camp is a luxurious tented camp in the heart of Serengeti National Park. The rooms are equipped with all the comfort you can expect from a five-star accommodation. What’s more, they are specially designed to make sure you have an incredible view over the Serengeti plains, even when lying down on your bed. Sleeping in an accommodation like this allows you to be in harmony with nature, but with a lot of comfort – a perfect combination. You can have an intense experience because you can see and (at night) hear the animals from very close by. Besides, Ole Serai is known for its excellent services and great food. Absolutely recommended!
blocks.html: Right in the heart of Serengeti National Park, Ole Serai Luxury Camp offers luxurious tented accommodation. Its rooms offer all the comfort you would expect from five-star accommodation. On top of that, they are designed so you have a wonderful view across the Serengeti plains, even while lying in bed. Staying in a place like this lets you live close to nature while enjoying plenty of comfort – an ideal mix. The experience is intense, as you can see and (at night) hear the animals very close by. Ole Serai is also known for its excellent service and good food. We warmly recommend it!
